title: A magyar megyék és a regionális fejlődés (Hungarian Counties & Regional Planning)
grammar: County Governance, Spatial Planning & Cities with County Rights in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say that Hungary has nineteen counties plus the capital.
I can describe the role of the county general assembly in regional development.
I can explain the special status of cities with county rights.
I can read a short text about the Hungarian counties (megye) and cities with county rights.

sections.title: A magyar megyék és a regionális közigazgatás
